settings.name: The Shrujan Campus
settings.copy: A behind-the-scenes visit, arranged in advance. You follow a piece from an idea through sampling and into production, and see how the design studio and the artisan communities actually work together. It is a visit about process, not a shop.

settings.image_alt: The walled fort at Lakhpat above the salt flat
settings.name: Kutch itself
settings.copy: The district the work comes from: craft villages within an hour of Bhuj, a museum built for the embroidery, and a landscape that turns to salt flat and back again. Come for a day, or plan a week around it.
settings.points:
Craft villages & workshops
The LLDC museum
Palaces, port towns, the Rann
